info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Banking Accounts Statements-v3-spec
info.description: The List Banking Account Statements API allows users to retrieve detailed statements for banking accounts. This endpoint provides access to historical data, enabling consumers to track transactions and monitor account activity effectively. Typical users include financial analysts, customer service representatives, and application developers looking to integrate financial data insights into their systems. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their reporting capabilities and offer better services to their clients.

get.description: Fetch the statements associated with a specific account, providing a comprehensive overview of transactions and balances over a defined period.

200.description: The request was successful, and the account statements are returned.
